text:
Pick up the no-V8 loader keystone. FIRST read this handoff FULLY, then execute it:
/tmp/handoff-20260608-114833-player-model-and-camera-in-the-no-v8-loader.md

It is complete and accurate — the prior lane (Claude) wrote it well. Your task per the handoff: a DRIVABLE camera + a PLAYER MODEL in the no-V8 loader so the user can move through the world it already renders. Follow it; it has the file map (with line numbers), the SDL input hook, the camera-math notes, the sun-direction gotcha, and the build commands.

CODEX-SPECIFIC GUARDS (you are being trusted with a lane that already burned a Claude session on overclaims — do not add to that):
1. NO STUBS, NO PLACEHOLDERS, NO SHORTCUTS. Do not fake a result. A prior lane tilted the CAMERA to make broken geometry "read as" correct and it was rejected on sight — do not do anything like that. If the real thing is hard, do it anyway or STOP and say why; never paper over it.
2. NEVER self-declare GREEN/PASS/done. A passing build / PNG-exists / no-V8 check is NOT proof it works. Only the USER running `tools/rjit game play` and seeing it counts. When you think it's ready, message the supervisor with EXACTLY: (1) `tools/rjit game play`, (2) what the user should see + the controls to try, (3) "not marked done, awaiting your verification." The supervisor relays; the user verdicts.
3. Stay in your OWN context — NO Task tool, NO subagents, NO Explore agents. The supervisor monitors your pane buffer; a subagent makes the work invisible and that is where this keeps going wrong.
4. tools/rjit only for build/run. Commit with EXPLICIT paths (NOT git add -A — ~400 unrelated set-aside files in the tree). No git reset/revert.
5. Don't regress the working render: each map renders its OWN scoped pieces (no global-pool merge), env/lighting/camera-start are DATA not hardcode, zero V8 in the loader. /test is the ground-truth comparison.

Report to the supervisor when you have a real build for the user to drive. Nothing is done until the user confirms with their eyes.
resolution: Added a runtime box-avatar instance batch to the no-V8 world loader and a third-person drivable camera: WASD moves the player camera-relative, Shift sprints, mouse drag orbits, wheel zooms. Spawn selects baked floor/low surface data and the camera mutates the existing Scene3D camera node per frame, preserving the no-V8 loader/render path and scoped map instance stream. Built/rendered a headless PNG for inspection; not marked done, awaiting user verification via tools/rjit game play.
